about: Which tile an address names (tile=, to=, a follower's source) among the tiles a window has: the one tile, why none has it (none), or the refusal when several do (refused). A plain name is the caller's own to read after these (name). Made by outline-core's parseTileAddress(), resolveAddress(), resolveRelative() and whyNone(), in the order the door's desk asks them; never edited by hand.
